title: chore(pm): stop teaching target: as the release-blocker mark in three PM tools
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95MtRuVUJMXGzrVSFps2r9x)_

Fixes #32956

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三个 PM 工具（`ensure-pm-labels.sh`、`record-recognisers.mjs`、`check-half-states.mjs`）不再把 `target:` 标签说成发版阻塞标记；`ensure-pm-labels.sh` 停止创建 `target:v17`。
- 为什么改：现行规则下发版阻塞只在发版窗内升 `priority:p0`，其余一概不算；工具还在教旧的 `target:` 板，信工具的席位会打一个发版清单不再读的标签，阻塞卡就看不见了。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `scripts/pm/` 内部工具的注释、说明文字和一条信箱表行，不改任何判定、不发布任何包；已存在的 `target:*` 标签对象原样保留。回滚即还原本 PR 的提交。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` 末尾原 `target:` 循环处（删循环、换成说明）；`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `notify:release-blocker` 行；`check-half-states.mjs` H67 摘要句与其自测断言。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs`，预期三条全过、无 `target:` 字样被当作阻塞标记。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。（另：仓里现存的 `target:*` 标签对象删不删由你定，本 PR 不删。）

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`
  - The `target:MAJOR` loop is removed: the file no longer seeds `target:v17` in objectstack, objectui and cloud. In its place, a comment says why there is no `target:` family: a release blocker is `priority:p0` inside the release window and nothing else (`references/filing-gate.md` 定级判据, which says 「⛔ 不打 `target:`」), and the maintainer's release list is `label:priority:p0 is:open` per repo (`references/seat-post-protocol.md` 〈发版板运维〉).
  - Seeding was stopped rather than reworded because nothing reads the label as the script described it (see Acceptance notes for the search), and `--reconcile` would actively rewrite an existing `target:v17` object's description to "Release blocker for v17". Existing `target:*` objects are left exactly as they are, the same way the header already treats a retired lane's objects.
  - The objectos, hotcrm and mobile enrolment comments drop the clause "OUT of the target:MAJOR loop", since that loop no longer exists.
  - The `priority:p0` and `pm:blocking` comments named the old pull order (`p0 > pm:blocking > target board > Bug > …`, citing a `SKILL.md 选择优先级` section that no longer exists). They now name the current label order (`p0 > pm:blocking > 功能点位次 > p1 > p2 > p3`, `references/execution-duties.md` 取卡全序), and the p0 comment says a release blocker sits there as p0 inside the window.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`: the `notify:release-blocker` roster row now reads `from:` the release-board producer (the director seat in this repository; the whole-repository seat in cloud), `to:` the lane the card sits in, `when:` a card is raised to `priority:p0` as a release blocker inside the release window. This matches `project-forms.md` (「发版板生产者→车道 `Notify: release-blocker`」) and `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈发版板运维〉. The key, template and field reader are unchanged, so every knock that read before still reads.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (H67 area, report-only, no verdict change): the block comment and the `H67_SELECTION_ORDER_LABELS` docblock said the plan skips "`target:` board membership". They now name the legs it really skips (功能点位次, and the two legs above the label order) and say a release blocker needs no leg of its own because it is `priority:p0`, which the first rank already reads. The H67 coverage clause in the summary line says the same in one sentence.
  - **Forced test edit:** the H67 battery case "what the order does NOT model" asserted the old phrase `⛔ not \`target:\` board membership`; it now asserts `⛔ not the 功能点位次 leg`. Battery count unchanged (158/158).

## Why

The p0-only ruling (card #32906, landed by PR #32918) made `priority:p0` inside the release window the only release-blocker mark. These three tools still taught the old `target:` board in their help, label descriptions and findings, so a seat that trusted the tool over the reference would write a label the maintainer's release query no longer reads, and the blocker would be invisible.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `5278 cases pass` (H67 battery 158/158).
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `399 cases pass`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs` → exit 0, `46 label descriptions … all ≤100 characters`; `--self-test` → exit 0.
- `bash -n scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` → exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `164 cases pass` (it pins the mailbox roster against `project-forms.md`).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` → exit 0.

No ablation: the diff changes comments, descriptions and one roster row's prose, not a tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Readers of `target:` searched at base 27c2f1ea (`git grep` for `target:v1N`, `label:target`, `target:*` and quoted `target:` across the repo): no script, workflow or reference reads a `target:` label as a release blocker. Two human-facing mentions remain outside this card's surface: `ROADMAP.md` points readers at "milestones and the `target:*` labels" for release targets (a planning use, not a blocker), and `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` says hotcrm has no `target:*` labels (still true). Neither is changed here.
- `scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs` keeps `"Release blocker for $V …"` / `for V in v17` in its header as the example of shell-variable expansion, and its self-test uses the same literal. The example no longer exists in the file it reads; it is a stale example, not a rule, and it is outside this card's file surface. carrier: none.
- Whether the existing `target:*` label objects are deleted is the maintainer's call; this PR deletes nothing.

## Verification

Local gate round on head `633f9b78` (after the last commit): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 49 commands from the three `scripts/pm/` paths; all 49 ran, all exit 0. Eleven of them first stopped at `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3, no `node_modules`); they were re-run after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and the codes below are from that run. `--ran` reconciliation: `49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `check:pm-dispatch-gates` fast tier: `2205 cases pass; 9 slow section(s) deferred`. Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
